Best AI video tools for training teams in 2026

Training videos used to mean a camera, a presenter and a lot of re-shoots. AI video tools let learning and development (L&D) teams turn a script or document into a finished video, often with an AI presenter. This guide compares 15 tools Ellnow lists, grouped by the job you need done, with each tool's pricing model and editor's score.

Scores are Ellnow's editor's scores out of 5, not user reviews. Pricing is as listed by Ellnow, so confirm current prices on each tool's site. Some links may be affiliate links; see our Terms.

Best for training and L&D videos

Colossyan is listed as an AI video platform built for L&D teams, and Synthesia and HeyGen are the two highest-scoring avatar video tools here. All three create videos with AI presenters from a script.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best AI video tool for training videos?

Colossyan is listed as built for L&D teams, while Synthesia and HeyGen have the highest editor's scores among avatar video tools here (4.6 / 5). The best fit depends on whether you want an AI presenter, a script-to-video tool, or an editor for footage you've already recorded.

What are the best alternatives to Synthesia?

Among the tools Ellnow lists, HeyGen, D-ID, Colossyan and Hour One also create AI presenter videos. Compare them with the table on this page, and check each tool's own site for current pricing and features.

Do I need a camera to make an AI training video?

Not with avatar tools. Synthesia, for example, is listed as creating videos with avatars from a script, with no camera needed. Tools like Descript and Veed.io are for editing footage you've already recorded.

Are there free AI video tools for training?

Yes. 9 of the 15 tools listed here are free or have a free plan, including Descript, D-ID, Captions and Supercut. Free plans are usually limited, so check each tool's site for current limits.

How are the scores on this page decided?

They're Ellnow's own editor's scores out of 5, not user reviews. Paid placements and affiliate links never change a score.
